title: Connect Postiz Facebook and Instagram providers through a Meta Login for Business configuration
scope: Add the reviewed Meta Login for Business configuration identifier to Facebook and standard Instagram authorization URLs
Keep canonical redirect URIs and existing token exchange behavior unchanged
Deploy through the official DappGo release path and verify the DappGo Facebook Page and Instagram Business connection
non_goals: Do not print, rotate, or commit credential values
Do not publish or schedule social content
Do not change unrelated providers or permissions outside the reviewed Meta configuration
acceptance_criteria: Authorization URLs include the configured Meta Login for Business config_id when configured and preserve a safe fallback when absent
Regression tests cover Facebook and standard Instagram URL construction with and without config_id
The selected DappGo Page and Business identities remain the only production assets used for verification
The reviewed image is deployed through the official release path with immutable source and image evidence
A fresh Facebook provider connection and a fresh Instagram provider connection complete without Authentication failed
Postiz health is fresh and no new provider OAuth failure is present in the verified logs
No credential values, OAuth codes, or access tokens are printed or committed

provenance.diagnosis: Meta Login for Business configuration was missing from the authorization request
